newsitem.title: USA: NYS COMPTROLLER MCCALL SEES LEVEL Q4 DEBT SALES.
newsitem.headline: NYS COMPTROLLER MCCALL SEES LEVEL Q4 DEBT SALES.

text.p: New York State Comptroller H. Carl McCall on Wednesday said he expected the state, agencies and localities to sell around the same amount of debt in the third quarter as in the previous period.
"I think the fourth quarter borrowing should be about the same level," McCall said in an interview with RFTV that was scheduled to be broadcast shortly.
The state comptroller, who coordinates such bond sales to ensure that they do not clash with each other, had forecast third quarter debt sales at about $3.158 billion.
